About Me
PLANNING
ENGINEER

I'm a Planning Engineer with 3+ years of experience on large-scale residential and infrastructure projects in Egypt and the UAE — with a combined contract value exceeding 7.5 Billion EGP.

My core expertise spans Primavera P6 scheduling, EVM analysis, EOT claims (TIA & Windows Analysis), and S-Curve reporting. I work across contractor and developer environments, coordinating with tier-1 clients like Emaar – Eagle Hills and international consultants.

Beyond traditional planning, I build custom digital tools that automate manual workflows — from villa progress trackers to full P6 analytics dashboards — bringing real-time project visibility to teams on the ground.

◀ Tool
📊
Planning Engineer Dashboard
P6 XER/XML Analytics Platform
A fully self-contained analytics dashboard for Primavera P6 data — built entirely in HTML/JS with no server required. Import your XER or XML file and get instant project intelligence.
  • 7 interactive tabs: Overview, EVM, S-Curves, Activities, Critical Path, Look-Ahead, WBS Tree
  • Mathematically rigorous EVM formulas (CPI, SPI, TCPI, EAC, ETC)
  • Dual Baseline/Update XER comparison with variance analysis
  • WBS tree grouping across Activities, Delayed, and Look-Ahead tabs
  • S-Curve visualization powered by Chart.js
  • Float analysis & delay detection with filter controls
🏖️
Soul Project Villa Tracker
143 Villas · Soul Luxury Beach Resort
A standalone field progress tracking app built for the Soul Luxury Beach Resort (North Coast) — covering 143 fully finished villas across 11 zones and 11 villa types.
  • Real-time unit-level completion tracking per villa
  • Multi-level activity hierarchy (Zone → Unit → Activity)
  • Login & access control system for field engineers
  • Google Sheets sync via Google Apps Script (JSONP)
  • Replaced 100% of manual update workflows
  • Live progress visibility for PM and consultant teams
🇦🇪
Globe Building Progress Tracker
30-Floor Residential Tower · JVC, Dubai
A remote-optimized field tracker for a 2B+G+5P+25F+R residential tower in Jumeirah Village Circle, Dubai — enabling real-time project control from Egypt.
  • Floor-by-floor progress tracking (30+ floors)
  • Real-time status updates for remote PM visibility
  • Activity-level completion per floor
  • Built for Globe Building Contracting (UAE), Prescott Real Estate client
  • Eliminated need for manual weekly field reports
